board: LEDBrick Plus emitter (hardware ledbrick_plus_led) on the 8-channel controller (rv_ledbrick_8ch)
description: The LEDs in each channel's string, as built. tools/led_curves/gen_led_models.py turns this into default_channel_leds() in led_models.cpp. Models are ids from builtin_led_models(). emitter_netlist.json has the schematic analysis this came from.

channels.name: WW
channels.as_built: The schematic has 2 LUXEON C Deep Red (L1C1-DRD) and 2 PC Amber (L1C1-PCA). Built boards have PC Amber in all 4 places.

channels.name: PCBlue
channels.note: Also a 0-ohm jumper in the string.

channels.name: V
channels.note: The 2 UV LEDs (VIOSYS CUN8, full part number not in the design files) have no published curve, so they use the standard LED. Also a 0-ohm jumper in the string.
